Our travel team reports two of our engineers (Karthik and Diego) have flights marked as delayed/cancelled; Rishi's inbound is still showing as on-time but I'll keep an eye.

- Convert to virtual for tomorrow 2pm. That avoids the risk of execs not being able to get to the venue.
- Offer Atlas a partial F&B credit (we can absorb up to $1,200 from event budget; procurement to confirm).
- Confirm whether Marissa does live demo or pre-record.
